sophia: Quick a11y check on the search facet checkbox group in the left sidebar — keyboard + screen reader quirks after the latest layout tweak. Screenshot attached. TL;DR: focus ring nearly invisible in dark theme, no group announcement for the set, and SR doesn't read updated counts when filters apply. @maria @james :eyes: james: Yep saw this. On Chrome+NVDA the inputs read as 'checkbox' but there's no group label. HTML currently looks like
    • ... so SR won't announce the context. maria: We should either wrap with
    or add role="group" + aria-label. If these are custom checkbox divs we need role="checkbox" + aria-checked and full keyboard handling. kevin: Also the focus outline in dark mode is too faint. Current focus against #0f1720 is basically invisible (users reported losing focus). Proposed CSS: .facet-checkbox:focus { box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px #FFD580; outline: none; } — box-shadow avoids layout shift. a11y-bot: Automated note: color-contrast failure on .facet-checkbox:focus against background #0f1720 — contrast ratio 2.1:1 (WCAG AA/AAA fail). james: Another thing: when you apply filters we update the results count in the header but screen readers don't always announce it. We need an aria-live region (polite) that updates with: "Filters applied — 3 results" so SR users hear the change. maria: Agree. Use a single visually-hidden
    that we update on change. Avoid spamming on every keypress. sophia: Can we also improve keyboard nav? Right now tabbing focuses every checkbox (fine), but arrow keys don't move within the group which is common expectation for some users. Should we implement roving tabindex so arrows move up/down and Space toggles? kevin: Roving tabindex is fine for a custom control. If we keep native we get native behavior (space toggles). Don't add duplicate key handlers for native inputs. For custom widgets: up/down arrow to change focus + space/enter to toggle + Home/End to jump. james: Edge case: the "Select all" looks like a button visually but acts like a checkbox that toggles all. Make sure it exposes aria-checked or aria-pressed consistently and uses aria-controls to point to the list it toggles. maria: Suggested markup examples to copy into PR comments: 1) Native (recommended):
    Size
    2) Custom (if we must):
    Small
    sophia: I added a tiny PR draft with the fieldset + aria-live region + CSS contrast tweak: https://github.com/redwood-inference/ui/pull/1234 — can folks review contrast token and SR update logic? a11y-bot: Reminder: run screenreader smoke tests (VoiceOver + NVDA) after the PR lands. james: :thumbsup: I'll run VoiceOver tomorrow morning and post notes. maria: I'll run NVDA and check keyboard roving behavior. kevin: I'll update the design token for focus ring and push changes to branch facet-a11y-fixes today. sophia: Awesome — thanks everyone. If reviewers find no further regressions I'll mark this resolved in the design sweep. :sparkles:
